title: ELO button, Elo Test with replays, and admin Elo control
notes: 📈 New ELO button at the top of every page: see all your ratings and change them in one place.

▶ Replay your Elo Test games move by move, with play, pause and step buttons.
Admins can now set any player's online rating.
